pattern: SELECT .+ COUNT\(*\) as [a-zA-Z]+_\d+\sFROM\s[a-zA-Z]+\w+\sWHERE\sIsOfficial = 'T'\sGROUP BY\s.+\sORDER BY\scountry_count DESC LIMIT 1
correction: SELECT T2.[Language_Column] FROM country AS T1 JOIN countrylanguage AS T2 ON T1.[CountryCode_Column] = T2.[CountryCode_Column] WHERE T1.[Continent_Column] = 'Asia' GROUP BY T2.[Language_Column] ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1

metadata.description: This rule corrects queries that incorrectly count the number of official languages for each country, instead of counting all languages spoken in a specific continent.
